scope: Nonperiodic GPU neighbours, drift, restart state and transactional escape rejection; no plane contacts or wall physics

gates.pairs: Exact unique canonical pair set versus independent Euclidean all-pairs; two domain sizes including a single bin and a cutoff exceeding half the shortest length
gates.opposite_faces: Exactly zero candidate pairs, contacts and force for the specified separated centres
gates.escape: All six faces: flag exactly 2048 and bit-identical rollback of all exported state, followed by successful advancement
gates.drift: 40 steps at prescribed free velocity, position absolute error <=3e-10 m; skin rebuild bound <skin/2
gates.restore: Bit-identical exported state after ten continuation steps, compared with uninterrupted advancement
gates.rate_rejection: Nonzero affine rate rejected before mutation, all exported state bit-identical

regression: Run existing serial Metal suite with no relaxed assertions
limitations: Domain bounds apply to centres, not whole grain surfaces
Computational cell volume is not a wall-confined specimen volume
